Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler refused my request because the Gateway has no credentials for it, so nothing is scheduled and nothing has been posted. I've left the scheduler as it was. Once someone with Gateway admin access fixes the scheduler credentials, I can set it up for Monday 19 October at 08:00 Chicago time.

When it's set up, the digest will cover #coastal-team and #coastal-random. It will leave out finance figures (money terms and finance documents), since those can't go into this channel without approval from Anselm or June. Operational items such as seat counts, renewal dates and ticket numbers can still go in.
